purpose: Resolve Batch 005 selection deadlock with an explicit reproducible ordering policy rather than memory or ad hoc choice.

ordering_policy.interface_rule: A subject already absorbed as a prior batch interface does not count as an independent completed subject unless it had its own batch closure.

selection_method: Apply the locked ordering policy to the Quran-wide subject universe, exclude independently completed subjects, then choose the earliest remaining subject. The queue is a new canonical production control asset, not a recovered historical artifact.

selection_basis.note: Selection follows the explicit queue policy; it is not claimed as recovered historical order.
